guides.concept: 先用「內外間隔差別」建立判讀邊界。內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate inner and outer spacers to define the interpretation boundary. Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜內外間隔差別：檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜低介電材料：檢查結果是否能支持「低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜間隔模組放行：檢查結果是否能支持「尺寸、覆蓋、低電容及釋放後存活須共同成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate inner and outer spacers: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare low-k materials: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the spacer module: Check whether the evidence supports: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「低介電材料」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「間隔模組放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare low-k materials: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the spacer module to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「內外間隔差別」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「低介電材料」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate inner and outer spacers and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare low-k materials and add discriminating evidence.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a defect report with confidence intervals and limits: Explicit denominators and uncertainty enable comparison. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify carriers and lots to define the interpretation boundary. Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識載具與批號：檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜瓶頸利用率：檢查結果是否能支持「高平均車速不能證明最繁忙路段不塞車。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜搬運系統驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「產能、錯送防護、故障恢復及潔淨度均需證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify carriers and lots: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure bottleneck utilization: Check whether the evidence supports: High average speed does not exclude congestion on a busy segment. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the transport system: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs throughput, misdelivery prevention, recovery and cleanliness evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure bottleneck utilization: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the transport system to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：已派工與已送達可使用同一狀態。 應回到「瓶頸利用率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

guides.titleEn: DRAM capacitor fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「1T1C 儲存：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜1T1C 儲存：建立模型：讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復；位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓。
觀察站 2｜機械支撐：建立模型：高度增加同時提高機械整合難度；乾燥表面力可拉倒高柱結構。
觀察站 3｜電容整合審查：故障判讀與驗證：電性與結構證據需相互對應；電容結構合格不等於整個感測放大器合格。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration; Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage.
Observation station 2 | Mechanical support: construct and analyze: Greater height also raises mechanical integration difficulty; Drying forces can collapse tall structures.
Observation station 3 | Capacitor integration review: diagnose and verify: Electrical and structural evidence must correspond; Capacitor quality does not qualify sense amplifiers.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「機械支撐：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「電容整合審查：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Mechanical support: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Capacitor integration review: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只加高電容而忽略結構支撐」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating DRAM read as entirely nondisturbing", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Increasing height without considering support", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Defect units: construct and analyze: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects; One defect may appear on several layers.
Observation station 2 | Spatial patterns: construct and analyze: Spatial patterns suggest causes without proving uniqueness; Edge exclusion changes visible patterns.
Observation station 3 | Improvement verification: diagnose and verify: Inspection-sensitivity changes can mimic process improvement; Improvement reviews need comparable products/pattern mixes.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

Use Improvement verification: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「看到邊環就唯一指定某台設備」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.concept: 先用「規格與控制：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：控制線描述製程行為，規格線描述需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Specifications and control: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Control limits describe behavior; specifications describe requirements. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜規格與控制：建立模型：控制線描述製程行為，規格線描述需求；穩定製程仍可能不符客戶規格。
觀察站 2｜屬性資料：建立模型：缺陷數與不合格單位数不是同一分布；樣本數改變會影響比例圖控制限。
觀察站 3｜變更管理：故障判讀與驗證：重設控制線不能取代原因改善；新舊版本比較需防止挑選有利期間。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Specifications and control: construct and analyze: Control limits describe behavior; specifications describe requirements; Stable processes can still miss specifications.
Observation station 2 | Attribute data: construct and analyze: Defect counts and defective-unit counts differ; Sample size changes proportion-chart limits.
Observation station 3 | Change management: diagnose and verify: Resetting limits does not replace cause correction; Version comparisons must avoid cherry-picked periods.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「屬性資料：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「變更管理：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Attribute data: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Change management: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把上下規格限直接當控制限」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「一片多缺陷就算多片不合格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Using specification limits as control limits", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 晶圓表面清洗：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer surface cleaning: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「污染分類」建立判讀邊界。粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Classify contaminants to define the interpretation boundary. Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜污染分類：檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜沖洗置換模型：檢查結果是否能支持「僅靠出口平均值可能漏掉滯留區。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜潔淨交接單：檢查結果是否能支持「移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Classify contaminants: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Model rinse displacement: Check whether the evidence supports: Outlet averages can miss stagnant regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Complete the cleanliness handoff: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沖洗置換模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「潔淨交接單」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model rinse displacement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the cleanliness handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「沖洗置換模型」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify contaminants and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for model rinse displacement and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 晶圓廠微污染控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Microcontamination control in fabs: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立污染源地圖」建立判讀邊界。人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Map contamination sources to define the interpretation boundary. People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立污染源地圖：檢查結果是否能支持「人員、設備、氣體、液體與載具都是可能來源。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜容器浸出物：檢查結果是否能支持「化學液潔淨度會受包材與接觸時間影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜污染控制報告：檢查結果是否能支持「來源、傳輸、沉積與電性後果應分層呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Map contamination sources: Check whether the evidence supports: People, tools, gases, liquids and carriers are possible sources. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Audit container extractables: Check whether the evidence supports: Chemical purity depends on packaging and contact duration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Compile the control dossier: Check whether the evidence supports: Report source, transport, deposition and electrical consequence separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「容器浸出物」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「污染控制報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Audit container extractables: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Compile the control dossier to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「建立污染源地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「容器浸出物」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map contamination sources and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for audit container extractables and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: TSMC GIGAFAB facility-integration case study: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「工廠與供應鏈：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜工廠與供應鏈：建立模型：GIGAFAB 是製造組織與規模概念，不是一份公開設備配方；廠區公開位置不等於內部設備座標。
觀察站 2｜冗餘與切換：建立模型：重複設備可能仍共享失效來源；共用控制器也可能是單點失效。
觀察站 3｜公開案例審查：故障判讀與驗證：公開績效不能反推出專有控制配方；廣告目標與已量測成果應分開。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Fab and supply chain: construct and analyze: GIGAFAB describes manufacturing organization and scale, not a public equipment recipe; Public fab locations do not expose tool positions.
Observation station 2 | Redundancy and switching: construct and analyze: Duplicated equipment may share failure causes; Shared controllers can be single failure points.
Observation station 3 | Public-case review: diagnose and verify: Public performance does not reveal proprietary control recipes; Separate announced targets from measured achievements.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「冗餘與切換：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「公開案例審查：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Redundancy and switching: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Public-case review: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「用企業名稱推斷所有內部製程完全相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「有兩台設備就必然完全容錯」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Inferring identical internal flows from a company name", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming two devices guarantee complete fault tolerance", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜用孔深除以孔寬定義深寬比：深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define aspect ratio from depth and width: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Longer time preserves the same profile at unlimited depth.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

guides.title: 微機電慣性感測器製程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: MEMS inertial-sensor processing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「質量彈簧：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Mass and spring: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Static approximation needs operation below resonance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜質量彈簧：建立模型：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
觀察站 2｜沾黏：建立模型：表面力可能勝過微結構回復力；防沾黏表面也需相容性驗證。
觀察站 3｜溫漂校正：故障判讀與驗證：零偏溫漂與比例溫漂是不同校正項；溫度遲滯需要往返循環檢查。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Mass and spring: construct and analyze: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
Observation station 2 | Stiction: construct and analyze: Surface forces can exceed microstructure restoring force; Anti-stiction surfaces need compatibility checks.
Observation station 3 | Temperature calibration: diagnose and verify: Offset drift and scale drift are different corrections; Thermal hysteresis needs heating/cooling cycles.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沾黏：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「溫漂校正：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Stiction: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Temperature calibration: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「元件重量很小就不可能被表面力拉住」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming low weight prevents surface-force sticking", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

Observation station 2 | Top/middle/bottom CD: construct and analyze: Top-view profiles need not uniquely determine a section; Sidewall angle affects grayscale profiles.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Dimension report: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Copper-pillar microbump fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：需要截面元素分析與高度分布才能確認組成和共面性。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Composition and coplanarity require cross-sectional composition and height data. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「需要截面元素分析與高度分布才能確認組成和共面性」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Composition and coplanarity require cross-sectional composition and height data, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Copper-pillar microbump fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「焊墊與凸塊座標」建立判讀邊界。焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Pad and bump coordinates to define the interpretation boundary. Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜焊墊與凸塊座標：疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜阻障與焊料帽：量測分層截面及帽體積，將金屬間化合物與未反應焊料分開。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜組裝交接與抽樣：交付可追溯晶粒地圖及不確定度，挑選邊緣條件樣本進行接合驗證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Pad and bump coordinates: Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Barrier and solder cap: Measure layer-resolved cross-sections and cap volume; distinguish intermetallic from remaining solder. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Assembly handoff and sampling: Deliver traceable die maps with uncertainty and include edge-condition samples in bonding validation. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「阻障與焊料帽」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「組裝交接與抽樣」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Barrier and solder cap: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assembly handoff and sampling to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：以全片平均偏移代表每顆凸塊重疊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：總凸塊高度能代替各層組成檢查。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Using mean wafer offset to represent every bump overlap. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

Avoid: Using total bump height instead of layer-composition checks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

建立量測計畫：比較接合前後的接點高度與四線電阻。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。

Mark this question on your own diagram: Pressure, temperature and time jointly affect a joint. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare joint height and four-wire resistance before and after bonding. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。

guides.title: 熱壓接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Thermocompression bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「接合堆疊剖面」建立判讀邊界。上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Bond-stack cross-section to define the interpretation boundary. Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜接合堆疊剖面：畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜氧化與潤濕證據：比較接合面、開路位置與良品對照，避免只用一张低倍率截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜接合窗口的轉移限制：列變更矩陣與保留條件，至少含幾何、電性、界面和熱循環證據。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Bond-stack cross-section: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Oxide and wetting evidence: Compare bond faces, open-site maps and good controls rather than one low-magnification section. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Limits of process-window transfer: Document changes and holds using geometric, electrical, interface and thermal-cycle evidence. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「氧化與潤濕證據」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「接合窗口的轉移限制」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Oxide and wetting evidence: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Limits of process-window transfer to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：高電阻一律表示加熱不足。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Attributing every high resistance to insufficient heating. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：繪出中心至邊緣的套刻誤差向量。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Plot overlay-error vectors from center to edge. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「繪出中心至邊緣的套刻誤差向量」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Plot overlay-error vectors from center to edge, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「界定混合接合的兩種功能」建立判讀邊界。混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define the two functions of hybrid bonding to define the interpretation boundary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜界定混合接合的兩種功能：整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
觀察站 2｜區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲：教學例：1 µm 視窗的 0.2 nm RMS 與全片 20 µm bow 可同時存在；兩者不矛盾，也不能互相替代。
觀察站 3｜交付 W2W 資格證據封包：官方 2026 年 200 nm W2W 研究展示是有日期和試片範圍的里程碑；本課 1 µm 方墊算例不能被標為該流程複製。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define the two functions of hybrid bonding: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.

Observation station 2 | Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow: Teaching example: 0.2 nm RMS over a 1 µm window can coexist with 20 µm whole-wafer bow; neither contradicts nor replaces the other.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a W2W qualification-evidence package: The official 2026 200 nm W2W study is a dated test-vehicle milestone; this course's 1 µm square-pad examples are not reproductions of that flow.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區分粗糙度、凹陷與全片翹曲」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付 W2W 資格證據封包」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Distinguish roughness, recess and wafer bow: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a W2W qualification-evidence package to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
小區域很平不代表整片能無缺陷接觸。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.
A locally smooth area does not guarantee defect-free whole-wafer contact.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Die-to-die stacking: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 垂直晶粒堆疊改變熱路徑與可測性。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Vertical die stacking changes heat paths and test access. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。以實際多晶片排列比較封裝幾何；不是 Foveros、SoIC 或混合接合剖面。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：垂直晶粒堆疊改變熱路徑與可測性。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：標示每一層的電源、訊號、熱及測試連接。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare physical multi-chip geometry; this is not a Foveros, SoIC or hybrid-bond cross-section.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Vertical die stacking changes heat paths and test access. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Mark power, signal, heat and test paths for each layer. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜面向與拓撲：畫每層訊號、電源和背面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Orientation and topology: Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Interface sampling: List measurable quantities and blind spots per interface. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Failure-analysis order: Plan analysis order and retained controls. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接合界面抽樣」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interface sampling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Failure-analysis order to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有堆疊方向可共用同一接線圖。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：最上層影像可代表所有埋藏界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Reusing one net map for every orientation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using top-layer images for every buried interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Temporary wafer bonding and debonding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用薄化前後翹曲及解接合後殘膠量評估。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Evaluate warpage around thinning and residue after debonding. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用薄化前後翹曲及解接合後殘膠量評估」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Evaluate warpage around thinning and residue after debonding, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Temporary wafer bonding and debonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「載板材料選擇」建立判讀邊界。透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Carrier selection to define the interpretation boundary. Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜載板材料選擇：按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜化學與真空相容性：用見證件比質量、厚度和污染。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜完整轉移證據：提供三類資料與後段驗證保留點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Carrier selection: Build a material matrix against processing and release needs. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Chemical and vacuum compatibility: Compare witness mass, thickness and contamination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Transfer evidence: Deliver all three evidence types and downstream hold points. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「化學與真空相容性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完整轉移證據」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Chemical and vacuum compatibility: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Transfer evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：玻璃載板可自動相容所有雷射波長。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：外觀無裂紋即證明材料相容。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming glass is compatible with every laser wavelength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using crack-free appearance as compatibility proof. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 雷射隱形切割：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Laser stealth dicing: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 隱形切割的改質層在晶片內部。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：隱形切割的改質層在晶片內部。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：外觀切縫不足以證明內部裂縫路徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Visible kerfs alone do not establish the internal fracture path. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「外觀切縫不足以證明內部裂縫路徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Visible kerfs alone do not establish the internal fracture path, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 雷射隱形切割：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Laser stealth dicing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「光穿透條件」建立判讀邊界。焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Optical penetration to define the interpretation boundary. The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜光穿透條件：畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜研磨前後順序：比較先薄化與後薄化兩條流程。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜路徑驗收：建立變更矩陣和見證片組。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Optical penetration: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Grinding order: Compare thin-first and thin-later flows. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Route qualification: Build a change matrix and witness set. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「研磨前後順序」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「路徑驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Grinding order: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Route qualification to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：交換順序不影響薄晶粒強度。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Using one optical path for every wafer material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming order never affects thin-die strength. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Die picking and precision placement: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 拾取釋放與光學對準誤差分開。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Separate pickup/release error from optical registration error. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：拾取釋放與光學對準誤差分開。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用放置後位置分布與晶粒損傷率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Separate pickup/release error from optical registration error. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use post-placement position distributions and die-damage rate. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用放置後位置分布與晶粒損傷率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use post-placement position distributions and die-damage rate, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Die picking and precision placement: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「晶粒地圖身分」建立判讀邊界。晶粒座標需連結測試結果與取放紀錄以避免錯選。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Die-map identity to define the interpretation boundary. Die coordinates must link test results to placement logs. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶粒地圖身分：核對原點、列行與缺口方向。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜視覺標記：比較不同光照下的座標漂移。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜後段可接合性：交付逐顆座標、缺陷與來源追溯。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Die-map identity: Check origin, row/column and notch direction. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Vision fiducials: Compare coordinate drift under different illumination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Downstream bondability: Deliver per-die coordinates, defects and source traceability. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「視覺標記」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「後段可接合性」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Vision fiducials: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Downstream bondability to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：地圖尺寸相同就表示座標定義相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：影像解析度高即可消除識別偏差。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating equal map dimensions with equal coordinates. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming high image resolution eliminates recognition bias. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Observation station 3 | Rework and acceptance: Define paired acceptance criteria for product boundaries. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating filler percentage with modulus. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 扇出型面板級封裝：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Fan-out panel-level packaging: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較全域尺度、局部形變及邊緣區良率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The wafer photo provides circular-substrate/scale context, not footage of panel-level packaging. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare global scale, local deformation and edge-region yield. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較全域尺度、局部形變及邊緣區良率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare global scale, local deformation and edge-region yield, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 扇出型面板級封裝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Fan-out panel-level packaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「格式與設備邊界」建立判讀邊界。面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Format and tool boundaries to define the interpretation boundary. Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜格式與設備邊界：建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜曝光拼接：跨接縫設計線阻與套刻見證。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜規模化經濟：比較每良品成本及尾端風險。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Format and tool boundaries: List effective process areas at every station. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Exposure stitching: Use resistance and overlay witnesses across seams. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Scale economics: Compare cost per good unit and tail risks. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「曝光拼接」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「規模化經濟」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Exposure stitching: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scale economics to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Embedded-die packaging: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 嵌入晶粒的接觸開口與樹脂層要可追溯。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：嵌入晶粒的接觸開口與樹脂層要可追溯。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對晶粒傾斜、覆蓋厚度與導通圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Check die tilt, cover thickness and continuity maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對晶粒傾斜、覆蓋厚度與導通圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check die tilt, cover thickness and continuity maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Cavity and stackup: List worst-case geometry combinations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Via-to-pad alignment: Retain local residuals and capture boundaries. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Testing and failure analysis: Localize nets before destructive sectioning. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「開孔對位」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Via-to-pad alignment: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Testing and failure analysis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：名義腔深較大就不需公差分析。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：外框標記對準即可保證所有埋藏墊。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Skipping tolerances when nominal cavity depth is larger. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using frame alignment to guarantee every buried pad. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 玻璃穿孔製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Through-glass-via fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 玻璃通孔與矽通孔的材料破壞不同。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Glass and silicon vias have different fracture behavior. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為矽微柱，不是玻璃通孔 TGV，也不能據此推定玻璃加工形貌。 觀察側壁波紋與錐度；圖片沒有提供可複製的完整設備配方。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：玻璃通孔與矽通孔的材料破壞不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以裂紋、錐角及金屬附著力驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. These are silicon micropillars, not through-glass vias, and do not establish glass-processing morphology. Observe scallops and taper; the image does not supply a reproducible complete tool recipe.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Glass and silicon vias have different fracture behavior. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Verify cracks, taper and metal adhesion. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以裂紋、錐角及金屬附著力驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Verify cracks, taper and metal adhesion, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 玻璃穿孔製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-glass-via fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「玻璃組成」建立判讀邊界。玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Glass composition to define the interpretation boundary. CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜玻璃組成：指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜種子覆蓋：檢查入口、中央和出口截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜整合放行：保存孔群位置和失效類型。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Glass composition: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Seed coverage: Inspect entrance, middle and exit sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Integration release: Retain array location and failure class. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「種子覆蓋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Seed coverage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration release to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：雙面表面有種子即可證明孔壁相連。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all glass as one material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring wall continuity from seeded faces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 有機中介層製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Organic-interposer fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：檢查走線方向、堆疊及溫度對幾何的影響。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check routing direction, stack-up and temperature effects on geometry. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「檢查走線方向、堆疊及溫度對幾何的影響」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check routing direction, stack-up and temperature effects on geometry, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
