guides.title: 微環調變器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Microring modulators: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立回程相位：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。共振要求回程相位為整數 2π，幾何周長與有效折射率共同決定位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Establish round-trip phase: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Resonance requires integer-2π round-trip phase, set jointly by circumference and effective index. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立回程相位：模型與設計：比較加長環與增加有效折射率造成的共振移動。
觀察站 2｜選擇調變工作點：模型與設計：在固定雷射波長比較三個偏壓位置的動態響應。
觀察站 3｜交付頻譜與調變證據：量測與判別：以獨立溫度和輸入功率條件檢驗模型外推。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Establish round-trip phase: model and design: Compare resonance shifts from longer circumference and higher effective index.
Observation station 2 | Choose a modulation operating point: model and design: Compare dynamic response at three bias positions with fixed laser wavelength.
Observation station 3 | Deliver spectral and modulation evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Test predictions at independent temperature and input-power conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「選擇調變工作點：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付頻譜與調變證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Choose a modulation operating point: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver spectral and modulation evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「只要半徑相同共振波長一定相同」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「共振最深點一定是最高線性調變效率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Equal radii guarantee equal resonance wavelengths" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "The deepest point always maximizes linear modulation efficiency" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.titleEn: Silicon-photonic thermo-optic phase shifters: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 熱光調相效率與熱串擾要一起評估。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Thermo-optic efficiency and thermal crosstalk must be assessed together. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：熱光調相效率與熱串擾要一起評估。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較 Pπ、響應時間及鄰近光路漂移。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。

procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Thermo-optic efficiency and thermal crosstalk must be assessed together. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare Pπ, response time and neighboring-path drift. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare Pπ, response time and neighboring-path drift, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.

guides.concept: 先用「定義加熱與光學區：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。加熱器位置決定熱流路徑，金屬靠近波導也可能增加光吸收。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define heater and optical regions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Heater placement sets heat-flow paths, while metal near a guide can increase optical absorption. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義加熱與光學區：模型與設計：在截面同時標電流、熱流和光模態。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define heater and optical regions: model and design: Mark current, heat flow and optical mode on one cross-section.
Observation station 2 | Calculate a lumped time constant: model and design: Recalculate 2.00 ms and check the 63.2% step-response time.
Observation station 3 | Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Calculate a lumped time constant: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「加熱器越靠近光芯只有好處」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Moving a heater closer to the optical core has only benefits" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "The time constant is the time to full steady state" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 異質薄膜鈮酸鋰需處理材料軸向與界面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Heterogeneous lithium niobate requires crystal-axis and interface control. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：異質薄膜鈮酸鋰需處理材料軸向與界面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對光模態重疊、電極方向及接合空洞。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Heterogeneous lithium niobate requires crystal-axis and interface control. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check mode overlap, electrode orientation and bond voids. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對光模態重疊、電極方向及接合空洞」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check mode overlap, electrode orientation and bond voids, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「晶軸與偏振：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Crystal axes and polarization: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶軸與偏振：模型與設計：旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
觀察站 2｜光電速度匹配：模型與設計：從射頻相位斜率與光群延遲分別萃取兩個速度，列出頻率相依性。
觀察站 3｜封裝交接：量測與判別：在相同校正面比較裸晶與封裝曲線，保存去嵌入檔與偏壓條件。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Crystal axes and polarization: model and design: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
Observation station 2 | Velocity matching: model and design: Extract velocities independently from RF phase slope and optical group delay, including frequency dependence.
Observation station 3 | Package handoff: measurement and diagnosis: Compare bare-die and packaged curves at matched calibration planes and retain de-embedding files and bias conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「光電速度匹配：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「封裝交接：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Velocity matching: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Package handoff: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「混合與異質整合：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。對接已製成雷射與先接合材料再製作元件，是不同的流程與良率邊界。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Hybrid versus heterogeneous integration: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Attaching a completed laser and bonding material before device fabrication have different process and yield boundaries. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜混合與異質整合：模型與設計：繪出兩條流程並標示可以做 known-good-die 檢查的位置。
觀察站 2｜電流展布：模型與設計：將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
觀察站 3｜量產可測試性：量測與判別：設計封裝前後同參考面的測試矩陣，區分新失效與原有裸晶缺陷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Hybrid versus heterogeneous integration: model and design: Draw both flows and mark where known-good-die screening is possible.
Observation station 2 | Current spreading: model and design: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.
Observation station 3 | Production testability: measurement and diagnosis: Design pre/post-package tests at matched planes to separate new failures from pre-existing die defects.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「電流展布：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「量產可測試性：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Current spreading: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Production testability: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Case temperature always equals junction temperature. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 微轉印雷射晶粒整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Micro-transfer-printed laser integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 微轉印的拾取、釋放與鍵合要各有證據。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Micro-transfer pickup, release and bonding require separate evidence. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：微轉印的拾取、釋放與鍵合要各有證據。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：追蹤印章接觸、晶粒位置及最終導通。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Micro-transfer pickup, release and bonding require separate evidence. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Track stamp contact, die position and final continuity. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「追蹤印章接觸、晶粒位置及最終導通」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Track stamp contact, die position and final continuity, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.titleEn: Micro-transfer-printed laser integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「供體晶粒邊界：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。可轉印晶粒需在源晶圓上保留支撐與釋放路徑；元件良率和釋放良率分開計算。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Donor-coupon boundary: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Printable coupons need support and release paths on the donor; device and release yields are separate. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜供體晶粒邊界：模型與設計：畫出元件、錨點與犧牲層的概念截面，標明哪個測試在釋放前完成。
觀察站 2｜垂直與橫向耦合：模型與設計：畫三個誤差軸的敏感度，對照耦合功率與散射影像，避免單軸最佳化。
觀察站 3｜追溯編碼：量測與判別：建立供體位置、測試結果、印章批次和目標位置的關聯表並做一次反查。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Donor-coupon boundary: model and design: Draw conceptual device, tether and release-layer sections and mark tests completed before release.
Observation station 2 | Vertical and lateral coupling: model and design: Plot sensitivity on three error axes and compare coupled power with scattering images rather than optimizing one axis alone.
Observation station 3 | Traceability coding: measurement and diagnosis: Link donor position, screening result, stamp batch and target position, then perform a reverse trace.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「垂直與橫向耦合：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「追溯編碼：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Vertical and lateral coupling: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Traceability coding: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：單一最佳晶粒可以代表整片陣列良率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.title: 矽上量子點雷射研究：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Quantum-dot lasers on silicon research: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 量子點雷射研究成果要區分材料和系統層級。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish material- and system-level quantum-dot laser results. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：量子點雷射研究成果要區分材料和系統層級。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較閾值、斜率效率與老化條件。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish material- and system-level quantum-dot laser results. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare threshold, slope efficiency and aging conditions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較閾值、斜率效率與老化條件」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare threshold, slope efficiency and aging conditions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「量子點與量子井：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。三維載子侷限改變能態分布；量子點並不自動消除所有非輻射復合。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Dots versus wells: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Three-dimensional confinement changes the density of states; dots do not automatically remove nonradiative recombination. procedure: 觀察站 1｜量子點與量子井：模型與設計：比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Dots versus wells: model and design: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.
Observation station 2 | Carrier capture: model and design: Compare frequency response and bias curves to identify where one-lifetime fitting fails.
Observation station 3 | System integration acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Compare on-chip dot and external lasers at equal received-power targets, including service and cooling.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「載子捕獲：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「系統整合驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Carrier capture: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System integration acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：量子點會消除所有位錯造成的復合。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Quantum dots eliminate all dislocation-related recombination. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 半導體光放大器整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Semiconductor optical-amplifier integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: SOA 增益會飽和並引入放大自發輻射。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: SOA gain saturates and introduces amplified spontaneous emission. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：SOA 增益會飽和並引入放大自發輻射。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測增益對輸入功率與光學雜訊密度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: SOA gain saturates and introduces amplified spontaneous emission. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure gain versus input power and optical noise density. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測增益對輸入功率與光學雜訊密度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure gain versus input power and optical noise density, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 半導體光放大器整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Semiconductor optical-amplifier integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「放大器與雷射：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。SOA 以受激放大處理輸入訊號；不希望介面反射形成非預期雷射腔。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Amplifier versus laser: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. An SOA amplifies input signals by stimulated emission; interface reflections should not create an unintended laser cavity. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜放大器與雷射：模型與設計：比較有無輸入光時的光譜，區分寬頻 ASE 與窄頻自激峰。
觀察站 2｜ASE 頻譜：模型與設計：量測有無訊號兩種光譜，以相同解析頻寬估计 ASE 底噪。
觀察站 3｜系統驗收：量測與判別：建立不同路由與通道負載下的增益、BER 及熱矩陣。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Amplifier versus laser: model and design: Compare spectra with and without input to separate broad ASE from narrow self-oscillation peaks.
Observation station 2 | ASE spectrum: model and design: Measure spectra with and without signal and estimate ASE at identical resolution bandwidth.
Observation station 3 | System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Build gain, BER and thermal matrices across routes and channel loads.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「ASE 頻譜：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「系統驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for ASE spectrum: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：補回功率就能完全補回 OSNR。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：補回功率就能完全補回 OSNR。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Restoring power fully restores OSNR. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

guides.concept: 可程式光路需要校準而非只改控制字。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Programmable photonics requires calibration, not just control words. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：可程式光路需要校準而非只改控制字。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測相位控制矩陣與漂移後誤差。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Programmable photonics requires calibration, not just control words. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure the phase-control matrix and post-drift error. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Wavelength and chemical fingerprint: model and design: Choose two bands distinguishing hypothetical species plus a nonabsorbing reference band.

Observation station 3 | Long-term drift: measurement and diagnosis: Plan periodic blanks and known standards, distinguishing cleanable drift from irreversible damage.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 光子晶片量子光源：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子晶片量子光源：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「自發與受激：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。自發四波混頻可產生相關光子對；經典增益或明亮光譜本身不是量子證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Spontaneous four-wave mixing can create correlated pairs; classical gain or bright spectra alone are not quantum evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜自發與受激：模型與設計：將平均功率、單光子計數與符合計數分為三種不同觀察。
觀察站 2｜符合視窗：模型與設計：比較三種視窗的原始符合、旁窗背景及淨符合。
觀察站 3｜可擴展性證據：量測與判別：比較兩顆獨立源的干涉與跨晶片重複性，列尚未驗證的整合項。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design: Separate mean power, singles and coincidences as three different observations.
Observation station 2 | Coincidence window: model and design: Compare raw, side-window background and net coincidences for three windows.
Observation station 3 | Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare interference from two independent sources and cross-chip repeatability, listing unverified integration items.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「符合視窗：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可擴展性證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Coincidence window: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：觀測符合率一定等於光子對產生率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：觀測符合率一定等於光子對產生率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Observed coincidences always equal pair generation rate. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「晶圓座標：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Wafer coordinates: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶圓座標：模型與設計：以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。
觀察站 2｜電光同步：模型與設計：同步保存電壓、電流、光功率與時間戳，量測等待時間敏感度。
觀察站 3｜資料交接：量測與判別：交付可追溯的原始譜、晶粒圖、校正檔與不確定度，並重算一個抽樣晶粒。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Wafer coordinates: model and design: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.
Observation station 2 | Electro-optic synchronization: model and design: Record voltage, current, power and timestamps; test sensitivity to settling time.
Observation station 3 | Data handoff: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver raw spectra, die maps, calibration files and uncertainty; independently recalculate a sampled die.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「電光同步：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「資料交接：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Electro-optic synchronization: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Data handoff: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Untested dies automatically count as passes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Thermomechanical analysis of photonic packages: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 熱機形變會同時改變對準與有效折射率。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Thermomechanical deformation changes alignment and effective index. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：熱機形變會同時改變對準與有效折射率。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：結合位移量測、溫度場及光譜漂移。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Thermomechanical deformation changes alignment and effective index. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Combine displacement, temperature and spectral-drift evidence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「結合位移量測、溫度場及光譜漂移」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Combine displacement, temperature and spectral-drift evidence, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光路溫度漂移補償：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical-path thermal-drift compensation: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「受控量定義：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。功率、共振波長與相位不是同一受控量，鎖功率可能鎖在錯誤光譜位置。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Controlled quantity: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Power, resonance wavelength and phase differ; a power lock can select the wrong spectral point. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜受控量定義：模型與設計：在頻譜上標出工作點和誤差信號零點，列出可能的多解。
觀察站 2｜控制延遲：模型與設計：把延遲加入頻率模型，記錄階躍超越與振盪。
觀察站 3｜重新校準：量測與判別：建立版本化校正與安全回復設定，以未參與擬合的負載驗證。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Controlled quantity: model and design: Mark operating point and error-signal zeros and list ambiguous solutions.
Observation station 2 | Control delay: model and design: Include delay in the frequency model and record overshoot/oscillation.
Observation station 3 | Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis: Version calibration and fallback settings; validate on an unfitted load pattern.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「控制延遲：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「重新校準：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Control delay: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：誤差為零一定代表雷射和光路正常。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero error proves the source and path are healthy. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 封裝應力對光學相位的影響：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package-stress effects on optical phase: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 應力致相位包含幾何變化及光彈效應。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Stress-induced phase includes geometry and photoelasticity. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：應力致相位包含幾何變化及光彈效應。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用應變、偏振及相位差量測分離機制。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Stress-induced phase includes geometry and photoelasticity. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate mechanisms using strain, polarization and phase measurements. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用應變、偏振及相位差量測分離機制」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Separate mechanisms using strain, polarization and phase measurements, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Stress and strain: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Stress and strain: model and design: Audit units and never multiply a strain-optic coefficient directly by Pa.
Observation station 2 | Birefringence: model and design: Use polarization-resolved or interferometric measurements to separate amplitude imbalance and retardance.
Observation station 3 | Independent validation: measurement and diagnosis: Withhold independent strain/profile data and an unfitted load for validation.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 共封裝光學交換器整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Co-packaged-optics switch integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: CPO 光引擎靠近熱源也靠近短電通道。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: CPO optics approach both heat sources and shorter electrical channels. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：CPO 光引擎靠近熱源也靠近短電通道。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：共同配置電通道、雷射路徑及可維修性。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: CPO optics approach both heat sources and shorter electrical channels. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Co-plan electrical channels, laser paths and serviceability. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「共同配置電通道、雷射路徑及可維修性」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Co-plan electrical channels, laser paths and serviceability, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 共封裝光學交換器整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Co-packaged-optics switch integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「系統邊界：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。CPO 將光引擎靠近 ASIC，但外接光源、連接器與管理仍屬系統功耗與故障邊界。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with System boundary: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. CPO places optics near the ASIC, while external sources/connectors/management remain in system power and fault boundaries. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜系統邊界：模型與設計：畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。
觀察站 2｜供電與去耦：模型與設計：將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。
觀察站 3｜系統驗收：量測與判別：以完整流量與熱穩態測試矩陣交付，保留未測的角落。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | System boundary: model and design: Draw from power input to fiber ports and mark included/excluded terms.
Observation station 2 | Power and decoupling: model and design: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors.
Observation station 3 | System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a full-traffic thermal-state test matrix and explicit untested corners.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「供電與去耦：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「系統驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Power and decoupling: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical I/O chiplets: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光學 I/O 小晶片需有可比較的系統邊界。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Optical-I/O chiplets need comparable system boundaries. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光學 I/O 小晶片需有可比較的系統邊界。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：標示是否計入雷射、驅動器及接收器功率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Optical-I/O chiplets need comparable system boundaries. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: State whether laser, driver and receiver power are included. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「標示是否計入雷射、驅動器及接收器功率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: State whether laser, driver and receiver power are included, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「單向與雙向：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。每方向容量要獨立列示，雙向相加只是特定總量定義。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Direction accounting: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. List capacities per direction; their sum is a particular aggregate convention. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜單向與雙向：模型與設計：依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。
觀察站 2｜BER 統計：模型與設計：以測試位元數計算信賴上界，保留資料樣式與溫度。
觀察站 3｜比較展示：量測與判別：從官方案例做來源表，分開已展示、規劃和本課假設。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Direction accounting: model and design: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead.
Observation station 2 | BER statistics: model and design: Compute a confidence bound from tested bits, retaining pattern and temperature.
Observation station 3 | Comparing demonstrations: measurement and diagnosis: Build a primary-source table separating demonstrated, planned and hypothetical claims.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「BER 統計：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「比較展示：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for BER statistics: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Comparing demonstrations: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero observed errors proves exactly zero BER. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜產品與元件：模型與設計：建立完整產品、維修狀態與可接近端口清單，交由合格人員界定分類測試。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Product versus component: model and design: List product, service states and accessible ports for qualified classification planning.
Observation station 2 | Shutdown latency: model and design: Build the example timing budget and require qualified verification of actual emission, not a self-invented safe time.
Observation station 3 | Validation closure: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver fault-injection matrix, uncovered faults and qualified-laboratory verification items.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Shutdown latency: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Validation closure: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: 台積電 CoWoS 整合案例：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: TSMC CoWoS integration case study: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: CoWoS 案例的結構與其他橫向互連不同。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: CoWoS architecture differs from other lateral-interconnect examples. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：CoWoS 案例的結構與其他橫向互連不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對官方 CoWoS 變體與對應的中介層形式。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: CoWoS architecture differs from other lateral-interconnect examples. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check official CoWoS variants against their interposer approaches. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對官方 CoWoS 變體與對應的中介層形式」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check official CoWoS variants against their interposer approaches, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.titleEn: TSMC SoIC stacking case study: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: SoIC 案例不能以普通堆疊照片推定接合界面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An ordinary stacked assembly cannot establish a SoIC bond interface. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。以實際多晶片排列比較封裝幾何；不是 Foveros、SoIC 或混合接合剖面。

建立量測計畫：以公開平台資料標示接合、測試及熱邊界。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare physical multi-chip geometry; this is not a Foveros, SoIC or hybrid-bond cross-section.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An ordinary stacked assembly cannot establish a SoIC bond interface. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Annotate bonding, testing and thermal boundaries from public platform sources. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以公開平台資料標示接合、測試及熱邊界」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Annotate bonding, testing and thermal boundaries from public platform sources, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Vertical parasitics: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.

pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：已知良品表示晶粒在所有條件下絕對無缺陷。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

procedure: 觀察站 1｜名稱與版本：模型與設計：按官方日期將 Foveros-S、R 和 Direct 3D 分列，區分已提供與規劃中。
觀察站 2｜熱耦合：模型與設計：比較總功率相同的三種負載分布，保存每層最高溫。
觀察站 3｜證據化評比：量測與判別：交付功耗、頻寬、熱與測試的比較表，標註來源與假設。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Names and revisions: model and design: List S, R and Direct 3D by official revision, distinguishing available and planned offerings.
Observation station 2 | Thermal coupling: model and design: Compare three equal-total-power distributions and retain per-tier maxima.
Observation station 3 | Evidence-based comparison: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a power/bandwidth/thermal/test comparison with sources and assumptions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「熱耦合：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「證據化評比：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Thermal coupling: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Evidence-based comparison: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 Foveros 變體都具有完全相同的接合材料和架構。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.title: Intel EMIB 互連橋案例：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Intel EMIB bridge case study: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: EMIB 的局部橋接與整片中介層需分清。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish EMIB local bridging from a full interposer. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：EMIB 的局部橋接與整片中介層需分清。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較橋的位置、互連距離與基板區域。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish EMIB local bridging from a full interposer. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare bridge location, interconnect distance and substrate regions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較橋的位置、互連距離與基板區域」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare bridge location, interconnect distance and substrate regions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「局部橋接架構：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。嵌入橋在需要的區域提供高密度連接，與使用整片中介層的材料配置不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Local bridge architecture: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Embedded bridges provide dense local connections with a different material distribution from a full interposer. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜局部橋接架構：模型與設計：重畫原創概念剖面，標出橋、晶粒與有機基板，不複製廠商圖。
觀察站 2｜返回路連續：模型與設計：追蹤返回電流路徑並分析轉換點的共模與串音。
觀察站 3｜組合封裝驗收：量測與判別：用相同工作負載驗收完整路徑，不只測局部橋的傳遞。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Local bridge architecture: model and design: Draw an original section marking bridge, dies and organic substrate rather than copying vendor figures.
Observation station 2 | Return continuity: model and design: Trace return currents and inspect common mode/crosstalk at transitions.
Observation station 3 | Composite-package acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Accept complete paths under a matched workload, not only bridge transmission.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「返回路連續：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「組合封裝驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Return continuity: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Composite-package acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 EMIB 版本永遠都不可能含 TSV。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: No EMIB variant can ever contain TSVs. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: iSiPP 平台可用元件與服務版本需一致。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: iSiPP components must match the service/platform version. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：iSiPP 平台可用元件與服務版本需一致。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對官方元件清單、封裝介面及測試途徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: iSiPP components must match the service/platform version. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check official component lists, packaging interfaces and test paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對官方元件清單、封裝介面及測試途徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check official component lists, packaging interfaces and test paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。iSiPP200 與 iSiPP300 是不同平台，晶圓直徑不是唯一差異，也不能假設元件庫可直接互換。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Platform and wafer size: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 are distinct platforms; diameter is not their only difference and libraries are not interchangeable. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計：將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。
觀察站 2｜轉印材料：模型與設計：比較加入元件前後的損耗、相位和電性能，避免只看功能是否出現。
觀察站 3｜設計釋出：量測與判別：交付可追溯 manifest、已知限制和回歸結果，不宣稱公開文件等於完整流片許可。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Platform and wafer size: model and design: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits.
Observation station 2 | Transfer-printed materials: model and design: Compare loss, phase and electrical behavior before/after integration, not merely function presence.
Observation station 3 | Design release: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a traceable manifest, known limits and regression results; public documentation is not fabrication authorization.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「轉印材料：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「設計釋出：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transfer-printed materials: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Design release: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
