guides.title: 晶圓研磨與拋光：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer lapping and polishing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界」建立判讀邊界。裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP to define the interpretation boundary. Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界：觀察「厚度達標」與「保留薄膜達標」是否指向不同的量測。
觀察站 2｜分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動：比較材料容易反應但接觸不良，以及接觸充分但漿料狀態不合適的兩種情境。
觀察站 3｜整合晶圓放行與異常處置：確認「尚無證據」沒有被寫成「已證明合格」，不同量測仍保留其基準。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP: Notice whether target wafer thickness and target remaining film require different measurements.
Observation station 2 | Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: Compare a reactive surface with poor contact against good contact with unsuitable slurry condition.
Observation station 3 | Integrate wafer release and disposition: Ensure missing evidence is not recorded as demonstrated compliance and each measurement retains its reference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合晶圓放行與異常處置」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integrate wafer release and disposition to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把金屬 CMP 的選擇性直接當成裸矽拋光規格，先退回材料清單重新界定。
把所有變化歸因於轉速會忽略墊面或漿料；重新建立一因一變的比較。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If metal-CMP selectivity is treated as a bare-silicon specification, revisit the material inventory.
Attributing every change to speed ignores the pad or slurry; restore a one-factor comparison.

guides.title: 矽晶圓線鋸切片：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon wafer wire sawing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識晶向」建立判讀邊界。晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify crystal orientation to define the interpretation boundary. Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識晶向：檢查結果是否能支持「晶向標記要連到晶棒座標，不能以外觀代替繞射證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜總厚度變異：檢查結果是否能支持「TTV 是厚度最大與最小之差，不是表面粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜切片批次放行：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度、損傷、邊緣與追溯證據須同時交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify crystal orientation: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure total thickness variation: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release a slicing lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「總厚度變異」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「切片批次放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure total thickness variation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release a slicing lot to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨識晶向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：平均值相同就不必檢查片間分布。 應回到「總厚度變異」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify crystal orientation and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Equal averages eliminate the need to inspect wafer distributions. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure total thickness variation and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「分辨成長與沉積」建立判讀邊界。熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate growth and deposition to define the interpretation boundary. Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分辨成長與沉積：檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜橢偏膜厚：檢查結果是否能支持「光學膜厚反演需要折射率與堆疊假設。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜閘氧驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度圖、介面、漏電與可靠度缺一不可。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate growth and deposition: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Interpret ellipsometric thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Optical thickness extraction requires index and stack assumptions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the gate oxide: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs thickness mapping, interface quality, leakage and reliability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「橢偏膜厚」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「閘氧驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interpret ellipsometric thickness: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the gate oxide to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「橢偏膜厚」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret ellipsometric thickness and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 離子佈植摻雜：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Ion implantation doping: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「劑量與濃度」建立判讀邊界。面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate dose and concentration to define the interpretation boundary. Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜劑量與濃度：檢查結果是否能支持「面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜碰撞損傷：檢查結果是否能支持「佈植後的化學濃度不代表可用載子濃度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜佈植批次審查：檢查結果是否能支持「劑量、深度、均勻、損傷及活化缺一不可。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate dose and concentration: Check whether the evidence supports: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Map collision damage: Check whether the evidence supports: Post-implant chemical concentration is not active carrier concentration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review the implant lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Review dose, depth, uniformity, damage and activation together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「碰撞損傷」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「佈植批次審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map collision damage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review the implant lot to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「碰撞損傷」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map collision damage and add discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Map batch positions to define the interpretation boundary. Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜批次位置圖：檢查結果是否能支持「前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜Fick 通量方向：檢查結果是否能支持「擴散通量由濃度梯度而不是濃度本身決定。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜批次擴散驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「熱場、濃度輪廓、位置差異及量測校準需一併審查。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Map batch positions: Check whether the evidence supports: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Draw Fickian flux: Check whether the evidence supports: Diffusion flux depends on concentration gradient rather than concentration alone. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept batch diffusion: Check whether the evidence supports: Review thermal field, profiles, position effects and calibration together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「Fick 通量方向」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「批次擴散驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Draw Fickian flux: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept batch diffusion to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「批次位置圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「Fick 通量方向」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map batch positions and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw fickian flux and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Shallow-trench isolation fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「主動區邊界」建立判讀邊界。隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw active-area boundaries to define the interpretation boundary. Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜主動區邊界：檢查結果是否能支持「隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜底部與側壁成長：檢查結果是否能支持「不均勻成長可能造成入口先封閉。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜STI 整合放行：檢查結果是否能支持「填充、平坦、漏電與通道應力需共同符合要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw active-area boundaries: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare bottom and sidewall growth: Check whether the evidence supports: Uneven growth can close the opening prematurely. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept STI integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Fill, planarity, leakage and channel stress require joint acceptance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「底部與側壁成長」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「STI 整合放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare bottom and sidewall growth: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept STI integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「主動區邊界」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「底部與側壁成長」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw active-area boundaries and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare bottom and sidewall growth and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 應變矽通道整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Strained-silicon channel integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「應力與應變」建立判讀邊界。應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate stress and strain to define the interpretation boundary. Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜應力與應變：檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜拉曼位移：檢查結果是否能支持「峰位變化也需排除溫度及成分影響。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜應變整合結論：檢查結果是否能支持「需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate stress and strain: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Interpret Raman shifts: Check whether the evidence supports: Peak shifts require separating temperature and composition effects. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review strain integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「拉曼位移」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「應變整合結論」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interpret Raman shifts: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review strain integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「拉曼位移」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret raman shifts and add discriminating evidence.

guides.concept: 先用「選擇性定義」建立判讀邊界。在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define selectivity to define the interpretation boundary. Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜選擇性定義：檢查結果是否能支持「在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜鍺深度分布：檢查結果是否能支持「表面平均成分不能代表整層成分梯度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜SiGe 模組交接：檢查結果是否能支持「選擇性、活化、應變與接觸需求需共同驗收。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define selectivity: Check whether the evidence supports: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Map germanium depth profiles: Check whether the evidence supports: Mean surface composition cannot represent a depth gradient. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Complete the SiGe handoff: Check whether the evidence supports: Accept selectivity, activation, strain and contact requirements jointly. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「鍺深度分布」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「SiGe 模組交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map germanium depth profiles: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the SiGe handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「選擇性定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「鍺深度分布」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define selectivity and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map germanium depth profiles and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 埋入式電源軌整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Buried power-rail integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「電源與訊號分離」建立判讀邊界。埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate power and signals to define the interpretation boundary. Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電源與訊號分離：檢查結果是否能支持「埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜軌接觸落點：檢查結果是否能支持「通孔需要可靠落在軌上並維持周圍隔離。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜埋軌放行：檢查結果是否能支持「電性、隔離、熱相容與可佈線性需全部有證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate power and signals: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Place rail contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Vias must land reliably on rails while preserving surrounding isolation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release buried-rail integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Electrical, isolation, thermal compatibility and routability all need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「軌接觸落點」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「埋軌放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Place rail contacts: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release buried-rail integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電源與訊號分離」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「軌接觸落點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate power and signals and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for place rail contacts and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「自對準的含義」建立判讀邊界。自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define self-alignment to define the interpretation boundary. Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜自對準的含義：檢查結果是否能支持「自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜蝕刻後殘留：檢查結果是否能支持「聚合物與金屬殘留可能需要不同判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜SAC 放行：檢查結果是否能支持「導通、隔離、填充及套刻裕度必須一起驗證。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define self-alignment: Check whether the evidence supports: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Classify post-etch residues: Check whether the evidence supports: Polymer and metal residues need different interpretation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept self-aligned contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Continuity, isolation, fill and overlay margin need joint validation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「蝕刻後殘留」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「SAC 放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Classify post-etch residues: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept self-aligned contacts to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「自對準的含義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「蝕刻後殘留」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define self-alignment and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify post-etch residues and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「曝光波長匹配」建立判讀邊界。DUV 光阻須以相應波長資料選擇，不能以外觀判斷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。

procedure: 觀察站 1｜曝光波長匹配：檢查結果是否能支持「DUV 光阻須以相應波長資料選擇，不能以外觀判斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜邊珠去除：檢查結果是否能支持「去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Match exposure wavelength: Check whether the evidence supports: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Define edge-bead removal evidence: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the DUV coating: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness, edge, backside and defect evidence must accompany exposure handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「邊珠去除」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Define edge-bead removal evidence: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the DUV coating to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「曝光波長匹配」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「邊珠去除」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for match exposure wavelength and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define edge-bead removal evidence and add discriminating evidence.

Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜放大機制定義：檢查結果是否能支持「光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜感度解析度粗糙度：檢查結果是否能支持「降低曝光劑量不保證同時提升解析度與粗糙度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜光阻材料評估：檢查結果是否能支持「需用相同曝光、顯影及蝕刻基準比較候選材料。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define amplification: Check whether the evidence supports: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare sensitivity-resolution-roughness: Check whether the evidence supports: Lower dose does not guarantee better resolution and roughness together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a resist assessment: Check whether the evidence supports: Compare candidate materials with matched exposure, development and etch baselines. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「感度解析度粗糙度」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「光阻材料評估」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare sensitivity-resolution-roughness: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a resist assessment to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「放大機制定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「感度解析度粗糙度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define amplification and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 光罩缺陷檢測與修補：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Photomask defect inspection and repair: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「把透明、遮光與相位缺陷分欄」建立判讀邊界。三者對光場的作用不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate clear, opaque and phase defects to define the interpretation boundary. The three classes affect the optical field differently. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜把透明、遮光與相位缺陷分欄：三者對光場的作用不同。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜對遮光多餘區規畫局部移除：移除不得侵入應保留的圖形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜完成可追溯的缺陷關閉報告：關閉缺陷需要前後證據與接受條件。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate clear, opaque and phase defects: The three classes affect the optical field differently. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Plan local removal for excess opaque material: Removal must avoid intended features. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Complete a traceable defect-closure report: Closure needs before/after evidence and acceptance criteria. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「對遮光多餘區規畫局部移除」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成可追溯的缺陷關閉報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plan local removal for excess opaque material: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete a traceable defect-closure report to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「所有小顆粒都一定可忽略。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「修補深度越大越可靠。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "All small particles are negligible.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Deeper repair is always more reliable.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define target contours and editable mask regions to define the interpretation boundary. An inverse problem requires defined design freedoms. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define target contours and editable mask regions: An inverse problem requires defined design freedoms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Set minimum curvature radius and spacing: Mask writability constrains fine curvature. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver versioned mask, model and process window: Reproducibility needs complete inputs and constraints. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜將密集線分成兩種顏色：每個子集合的間距可大於最終間距。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

觀察站 2｜畫出套刻偏移造成的交替間距：相對位移會產生間距交替。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 45/35 nm 與不合格理由，明確指出平均值盲點。
觀察站 3｜交付兩組圖案的整合驗收：驗收需涵蓋單組與合併後性能。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Split dense lines into two colors: Each subset can have larger pitch than the final pattern. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Sketch alternating spaces caused by overlay shift: Relative displacement produces alternating spacing. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 45/35 nm and the failure reason, identifying the mean-value blind spot.

Observation station 3 | Deliver integrated acceptance for both pattern subsets: Acceptance must cover subsets and their combined behavior. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「畫出套刻偏移造成的交替間距」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付兩組圖案的整合驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch alternating spaces caused by overlay shift: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver integrated acceptance for both pattern subsets to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「只需把曝光時間加倍。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「兩次曝光平均位置正確就不會有局部錯誤。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Simply double the exposure time.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Correct mean placement prevents local errors.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing to define the interpretation boundary. Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分開區塊相分離與宏觀混合：共價連接限制兩區塊完全分離。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

觀察站 3｜提交模板、材料與缺陷證據鏈：可整合性需要位置、缺陷與轉移共同證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing: Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: Different defect classes indicate different failure mechanisms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain: Integrability needs combined placement, defect and transfer evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.concept: 先用「比較模板接觸與光學投影的資訊傳遞」建立判讀邊界。接觸轉移仍需光學或其他對位量測。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare information transfer by contact and projection to define the interpretation boundary. Contact transfer still needs optical or other alignment metrology. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較模板接觸與光學投影的資訊傳遞：接觸轉移仍需光學或其他對位量測。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜區分光固化與熱壓印的能量途徑：不同機制有不同材料與熱預算。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付有代表性圖形的壓印驗證報告：驗證需涵蓋密度與形狀多樣性。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare information transfer by contact and projection: Contact transfer still needs optical or other alignment metrology. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Distinguish photocuring from thermal imprinting: Different mechanisms have different materials and thermal budgets. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver imprint validation across representative patterns: Validation must cover density and shape diversity. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區分光固化與熱壓印的能量途徑」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付有代表性圖形的壓印驗證報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Distinguish photocuring from thermal imprinting: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver imprint validation across representative patterns to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「奈米壓印只靠提高投影鏡頭 NA。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「固化後可以忽略脫模力。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Nanoimprint works by increasing projection-lens NA.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Release force becomes irrelevant after curing.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 反應式離子蝕刻：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Reactive-ion etching: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出電子、離子與中性自由基」建立判讀邊界。粒子族群具有不同能量與方向性。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw electrons, ions and neutral radicals to define the interpretation boundary. Particle populations have different energies and directionality. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出電子、離子與中性自由基：粒子族群具有不同能量與方向性。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜畫出 OES 訊號與層間界面：發光強度不是直接膜厚。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付速率、輪廓、選擇性與損傷報告：RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw electrons, ions and neutral radicals: Particle populations have different energies and directionality. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Relate OES signals to layer interfaces: Emission intensity is not direct thickness. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Report rate, profile, selectivity and damage: RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「畫出 OES 訊號與層間界面」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付速率、輪廓、選擇性與損傷報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Relate OES signals to layer interfaces: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Report rate, profile, selectivity and damage to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「RIE 完全只有物理撞擊。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「亮度下降一定代表所有區域已蝕刻完成。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "RIE is purely physical bombardment.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Falling brightness proves every region has finished etching.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「畫出表面改質與移除兩個半循環」建立判讀邊界。反應分離是循環控制的核心。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw surface-modification and removal half-cycles to define the interpretation boundary. Separated reactions enable cycle control. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出表面改質與移除兩個半循環：反應分離是循環控制的核心。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜比較水平與垂直表面的移除：方向性取決於活化機制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付飽和、選擇性及電性證據包：自限制主張需要可重現實驗支持。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw surface-modification and removal half-cycles: Separated reactions enable cycle control. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Compare removal on horizontal and vertical surfaces: Directionality depends on the activation mechanism. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver saturation, selectivity and electrical evidence: Self-limitation claims need reproducible experimental support. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「比較水平與垂直表面的移除」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付飽和、選擇性及電性證據包」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare removal on horizontal and vertical surfaces: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver saturation, selectivity and electrical evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「任何分段電漿都可直接稱為 ALE。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「自限制就表示所有材料完全不受影響。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Any segmented plasma process is automatically ALE.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Self-limitation means all other materials are completely unaffected.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 濺鍍薄膜製程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Sputtered thin-film processing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出離子撞擊靶材與原子逸出」建立判讀邊界。濺鍍產率依入射與材料條件改變。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Sketch ion impact and target-atom ejection to define the interpretation boundary. Sputter yield depends on incidence and material conditions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出離子撞擊靶材與原子逸出：濺鍍產率依入射與材料條件改變。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜量測厚度地圖並計算均勻性：均勻性公式與取樣範圍需明示。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付厚度、介面、電性與覆蓋證據：薄膜用途決定驗收指標組合。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Sketch ion impact and target-atom ejection: Sputter yield depends on incidence and material conditions. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Map thickness and calculate uniformity: Uniformity definition and sampling range must be stated. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver thickness, interface, electrical and coverage evidence: Film application determines the acceptance metrics. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測厚度地圖並計算均勻性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付厚度、介面、電性與覆蓋證據」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map thickness and calculate uniformity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver thickness, interface, electrical and coverage evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「濺鍍就是把靶材煮沸。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「較厚薄膜一定較低應力。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Sputtering simply boils the target.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Thicker films necessarily have lower stress.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a contact from device to first metal to define the interpretation boundary. A vertical contact includes multiple material interfaces. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出元件到第一層金屬的接點：垂直接點包含多個材料介面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜檢查阻障與襯層的連續性：局部破口可能造成化學或擴散問題。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付填充、平坦化與接觸電阻審查：插塞驗證需跨越幾何與介面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a contact from device to first metal: A vertical contact includes multiple material interfaces. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Inspect barrier and liner continuity: Local gaps can cause chemical or diffusion problems. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review fill, planarization and contact resistance: Plug validation must cover geometry and interfaces. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「檢查阻障與襯層的連續性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付填充、平坦化與接觸電阻審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Inspect barrier and liner continuity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review fill, planarization and contact resistance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「鎢體電阻率即可決定所有接點電阻。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「襯層越厚一定越低電阻。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Bulk tungsten resistivity determines every contact resistance.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A thicker liner necessarily lowers resistance.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: Copper dual-damascene interconnects: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」建立判讀邊界。垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a via and trench between metal levels to define the interpretation boundary. Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充：超共形填充可避免過早封口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查：局部製程合格仍需跨層功能驗證。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a via and trench between metal levels: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: Superconformal fill can avoid premature closure. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a two-level RC and failure review: Local process acceptance still needs cross-layer functional validation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a two-level RC and failure review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「表面平坦可排除內部空洞。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A planar surface rules out internal voids.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶圓電化學銅填孔：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Electrochemical copper via filling: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出陽極、陰極與電解液的電流路徑」建立判讀邊界。電子與離子在不同路徑傳輸。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw anode, cathode and electrolyte current paths to define the interpretation boundary. Electrons and ions travel through different paths. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出陽極、陰極與電解液的電流路徑：電子與離子在不同路徑傳輸。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜繪製共形填充與自底向上填充：底部較快成長可減少封口空洞。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付電荷、截面與電性一致性報告：填孔成功需要多種相互支持的證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw anode, cathode and electrolyte current paths: Electrons and ions travel through different paths. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Sketch conformal and bottom-up filling: Faster bottom growth can reduce pinch-off voids. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver charge, cross-section and electrical consistency: Successful fill needs mutually supporting evidence types. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「繪製共形填充與自底向上填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付電荷、截面與電性一致性報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch conformal and bottom-up filling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver charge, cross-section and electrical consistency to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「通過多少電荷就保證全部都變成銅。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「孔口沉積最快就是最佳填孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "All passed charge is guaranteed to become copper.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Fastest opening deposition is the best fill.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「移除量與平坦度：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜移除量與平坦度：建立模型：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
觀察站 2｜研磨墊狀態：建立模型：墊表面演化會改變移除與均勻度；修整器磨耗也會改變墊狀態。
觀察站 3｜整合驗收：故障判讀與驗證：CMP 驗收必須連到後續整合要求；微影焦深需求與局部地形有關。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
Observation station 2 | Pad condition: construct and analyze: Pad evolution changes removal and uniformity; Conditioner wear also changes pad state.
Observation station 3 | Integration acceptance: diagnose and verify: CMP acceptance must connect to downstream integration; Lithographic focus needs depend on local topography.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「研磨墊狀態：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Pad condition: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只記累積片數而忽略墊狀態」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Recording wafer count while ignoring pad state", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 互連電遷移可靠度：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Interconnect electromigration reliability: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「電子流與原子遷移：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：原子通量與通量散度不是同一量。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Electron flow and atomic transport: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電子流與原子遷移：建立模型：原子通量與通量散度不是同一量；通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空。
觀察站 2｜微結構：建立模型：最快擴散路徑依材料與結構而異；介面黏著會改變機械約束。
觀察站 3｜使用情境：故障判讀與驗證：峰值、平均值與熱時間尺度不能互換；脈衝期間的熱峰值可能高於平均。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Electron flow and atomic transport: construct and analyze: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities; Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion.
Observation station 2 | Microstructure: construct and analyze: The fastest diffusion path depends on material and structure; Interface adhesion changes mechanical constraint.
Observation station 3 | Use-condition transfer: diagnose and verify: Peak, average and thermal time scale are not interchangeable; Pulsed thermal peaks can exceed averages.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「微結構：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「使用情境：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Microstructure: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Use-condition transfer: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「宣稱所有金屬都由同一擴散路徑主導」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Locating every void from a current arrow alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assigning the same dominant path to all metals", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates. procedure: 觀察站 1｜電荷儲存層：建立模型：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同；局域捕捉電荷可具有不同能階。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Phase and resistance: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜相態與電阻：建立模型：電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Phase and resistance: construct and analyze: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
Observation station 2 | Confined active volume: construct and analyze: Surrounding material need not transform each cycle; Active thermal volume can be smaller than electrode area.
Observation station 3 | Array endurance: diagnose and verify: Single-cell demonstrations and array reliability are different evidence; Endurance and retention need different test sequences.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 薄膜電晶體顯示背板：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Thin-film-transistor display backplanes: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「像素開關：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：背板控制與發光材料是不同功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Pixel switching: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Backplane control and light emission are different functions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜像素開關：建立模型：背板控制與發光材料是不同功能；像素保持需要低關斷漏電。
觀察站 2｜接觸與通道：建立模型：低通道電阻仍可能被接觸主導；接觸影響會扭曲表觀遷移率。
觀察站 3｜面板驗收：故障判讀與驗證：面板品質需要元件和光學共同驗證；亮度判斷應固定視角與光學條件。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Pixel switching: construct and analyze: Backplane control and light emission are different functions; Pixel hold requires low off-state leakage.
Observation station 2 | Contacts and channel: construct and analyze: Low channel resistance can remain contact-limited; Contact effects distort apparent mobility.
Observation station 3 | Panel acceptance: diagnose and verify: Panel quality requires device and optical evidence; Luminance assessment needs fixed viewing conditions.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸與通道：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「面板驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Contacts and channel: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Panel acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把 TFT 通道直接當成發光層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「全部低電流都歸為遷移率差」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating the TFT channel as the emitting layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Attributing all low current to poor mobility", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Observation station 2 | Dispersion model: construct and analyze: Transparent models cannot be extended blindly into absorption; Dispersion models require physical-consistency checks.
Observation station 3 | Report and limits: diagnose and verify: Thickness is a model-conditioned inference; Confidence reporting should include model limitations.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
